Keep enabled to cache DRM natively for internal playback. Disable to force unencrypted MP3 downloads via YouTube fallback.

DRM-protected tracks are encrypted by rightsholders to prevent extraction and protect copyrights.

• Enabled (Recommended): The track is downloaded in its native high quality to KittyTune's secure internal cache. It can only be played inside the app and will not appear in your configured download folder.

• Disabled: KittyTune will ignore the encrypted version and attempt to find and download the song via YouTube. The file will be converted to a standard MP3 and saved in your designated folder. Warning: Since the search is automatic, it may download incorrect content (such as a music video or a cover) if the track is not well-known.

Different songs are often recorded at different loudness levels. Volume normalization automatically balances your tracks so that every song plays at a consistent, comfortable volume without you needing to adjust it constantly.

How it works:
• KittyTune measures the true loudness of each song (in LUFS).
• During playback, volume is dynamically adjusted to match your selected target level.
• An integrated limiter prevents any distortion or clipping.

Levels:
• Quiet (-19 LUFS): Ideal for nighttime listening or headphones.
• Normal (-14 LUFS): The standard used by Spotify & YouTube.
• Loud (-11 LUFS): Best for noisy environments or outdoor speakers.

SoundCloud and media streaming servers are restricted or blocked in some countries (like Russia). Setting up a local proxy (V2Ray, Clash, Shadowsocks, Tor, etc.) or a remote proxy allows Kittytune to stream music, fetch track metadata, load album artwork, and play DRM-protected tracks without interruption.
